contest.name: His Majesty The King of Spain CW
contest.description: His Majesty The King of Spain CW Contest — third full weekend of May, 24-hour single window from 1200Z Saturday to 1159Z Sunday. Anyone may participate. Spanish stations send 2-letter province codes; DX stations send incrementing serial numbers (001+); the special station EF0F (HM the King of Spain) sends SMR. Multipliers are 52 Spanish provinces, the SMR special-station identifier, and EADX-100 entities (URE-curated, ~344 entities). Asymmetric per-direction scoring: EA→EA = 2 pts, EA→DX = 1 pt, DX→EA = 3 pts, DX→DX = 1 pt.
contest.startDate: Third full weekend of May, 1200Z Saturday to 1159Z Sunday (2026: May 16-17)

multipliers.description: Per-band multipliers: 52 Spanish provinces + SMR (His Majesty The King of Spain special station EF0F) + EADX-100 entities (URE list, ~344). EA-related entities (EA, EA6, EA8, EA9) are excluded from EADX-100 counting because Spanish stations contribute the more granular province multiplier — counting them via both namedMults (province) and eadx100 (country) would double-credit.

dupeChecking.description: A station may be worked once per band. CW only — no mode dimension.

callHistory.description: Save received province code (or serial number) for future lookups

exchangeValidation.description: Spanish stations send one of 52 province codes (1-2 letters) or SMR (the King's special station EF0F). DX stations send a 3-digit incrementing serial number. The engine recognizes the province codes as namedMults; serial numbers fall through and the operator's DXCC entity (looked up from callsign) provides the EADX-100 entity multiplier.
